quotes.speaker: Joel Embiid
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid on Tyrese Maxey's growth as a two-way player
quotes.excerpt: what does it mean to you to see Tyrese really kind of take that next step
quotes.quote: It's been great. Obviously, when you look at our team, we got a bunch of 6-6, 6-7 guys, you know, as far as the height. And Tyrese is kind of like the small guy out there, and usually those guys get picked, you know, consistently. And to have, you know, to look at our team and be like, who you going to pick on? There's nobody. And he's sticking our lip, he's sticking our step. A job that he did today picking up full court, I mean, credit, you know, to him. He's, you know, every single year it's been like that. He's getting better.

quotes.speaker: Joel Embiid
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid on the importance of veteran leadership during halftime adjustments
quotes.excerpt: that's a good thing about having a veteran team, you know, you just understand how the game
quotes.quote: We didn't really talk about a lot of halftime. We just we just knew what we had to do. Taking care of the ball, that was one. And two, just be a little bit more aggressive on defense. And that's what we did. So, you know, that's a good thing about having a veteran team, you know, you just understand how the game is going and what you have to do, and you go from there.

quotes.speaker: Joel Embiid
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid on his ongoing progress with rebounding and positioning
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I just forgot the feel of like rebounding and positioning
quotes.quote: I don't know. I think it's still a work in progress. One thing that I feel like I lost, you know, last, you know, three years that I haven't been healthy is like the, you know, I feel like I just forgot the feel of like rebounding and positioning. So that's something that I'm working on to, you know, it goes back to everything really, basketball related for me. Missing so much time that it's taking me a while to kind of, you know, put myself out there and be like, okay, this is what you know, this is what you do and this is what you used to doing and get comfortable and get back to it.
